name: Spiritual Healer (Geomancer Archetype)
body:
Geomancers can commune with spirits around them, but some can seek out and cast out the spirits of pain and suffering debilitating the living. These geomancers are called spiritual healers.

Healing Skill (Ex)

A spiritual healer can always prepare spells with the healing subschool. A spiritual healer also gains a +2 bonus on Heal checks which increases to +3 when used to provide first aid. This ability replaces elemental speak.

Drive out Pain (Su)

At 1st level, as a standard action, a spiritual healer can ameliorate pain felt by a target by either driving out the spirits causing the pain or using their understanding of the energy flowing through the target to return them to health. They use either Diplomacy or Heal skill checks against a DC depending upon the condition being removed. A spiritual healer cannot take 10 or 20 on this check. A failure by 5 or less means that the target is cured of the condition if the spiritual healer chooses to take the condition for the rest of the duration. A failure by 10 or more means the spiritual healer is affected by the condition and the target is not healed for the remainder of the duration.

Minor Conditions (DC 15): Fatigued, shaken, and sickened.
Major Conditions (DC 20): Dazed and staggered.
Severe Conditions (DC 25): Exhausted, frightened, and nauseated.
Dire Conditions (DC 30): Blinded, deafened, paralyzed, and stunned.

A spiritual healer can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1/2 their geomancer level + their Wisdom modifier. This ability requires either physical touch if using Heal, or audible components within 30 feet if using Diplomacy.

If a target is afflicted with multiple conditions, the spiritual healer targets one condition at a time (of their choosing). The spiritual healer cannot use this ability on themself.

At 5th level, a spiritual healer can use this ability to exorcise minor conditions without needing to attempt a Diplomacy or Heal check. They can remove major conditions without a roll at 9th level, severe conditions at 13th level, and dire conditions at 17th level. Doing so still requires one use of this ability per condition.

This ability replaces guardian spirits and all instances of spiritual boons.

Counter Curse (Su)

At 9th level, as a standard action, spiritual healer can expend 2 uses of their drive out pain ability to produce the effects of dispel magic or remove curse using their Wisdom as the spellcasting ability modifier and their class level as the caster level. This ability can only be targeted on themself or an ally. For each additional use of drive out pain expended, they gain a +2 sacred bonus on their caster level for the attempt to dispel or remove the curse. This ability replaces spiritual assistance.
